items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I see another record here with Sonny Greer... with Lester Young

ctx.x: I don't know the name of the studio, but we'd record every day. That was with Kay Starr; that was before she became a big name.
I see another record here with Sonny Greer, "Mood Indigo," "The Mooche"; with Lester Young, "You're Driving Me Crazy" and "The New Lester Leaps In" and the "D.B. Blues", "Lester Blows Again"...
